correctness.rationale: For every n>=1 each cyclic word supplies a nonnegative balanced connected Eulerian edge multiset on binary order-two de Bruijn states. The proof explicitly solves flow balance in variables a,b,c,d,f,h, partitions the three connectedness regimes for b,d with a separate disconnected-support exclusion, sums exact rational generating functions, and extracts an exact degree-four period-12 quasipolynomial. Both directions of Eulerian realization cover the n=1 and n=2 wraparound conventions. The dependency-free checker confirms equality of literal word profile sets and independently parameterized sets for n=1..18 and checks the formula via parameterized enumeration for n=19..46; no finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof. The primitive third- and fourth-root poles certify least period twelve.

value.rationale: The exact number of distinct outcomes of the full circular oriented length-three read multiset channel is the exact zero-error profile coding capacity for every length n; previous asymptotic c(2,3)=1/288 does not provide these finite values. Connectedness restrictions yield nontrivial exclusion of balanced but unrealizable disconnected profiles and create nonobvious least-period-twelve lower-order fluctuations. This is a natural global exact invariant, rather than an arbitrary sample or routine parameter substitution. The result does not claim efficient encoding, general alphabet sizes, or fiber-size classification.
